meta.title: Suggestions Register
meta.purpose: Reviewable proposals. Nothing here is implemented automatically. Each has an impact estimate, a cost, a dependency and a reversible step, so a reviewer can choose the best path.
meta.decision_column: status: proposed | accepted | rejected | deferred (owner sets)

suggestions.title: Publish an evidence grade on every table row
suggestions.problem: A reader cannot tell a league-verdict value from a club self-report at a glance.
suggestions.proposal: Add a per-row badge: A = league-published fact, B = club-published, C = derived by our own documented join, U = unverified. Filter and sort by badge.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Lets a reviewer apply a different trust threshold to A than to B without reading the methodology each time.
suggestions.first_step: Add the badge column to the generated tables and a legend on the Sources page.
suggestions.risk: Badge inflation — someone marks a B as an A to close a flag. Mitigation: badge is set by the generator, not by hand.

suggestions.title: Add a 'staleness clock' to every page
suggestions.problem: Injury and schedule data decay within days, but a static page looks equally authoritative on day 1 and day 30.
suggestions.proposal: Render hours since retrieval next to each table; past 72 hours, show an amber banner; past 168 hours, show a red one saying the table must not be used for decisions.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Prevents a decision being made on a snapshot the reader believes is live.
suggestions.first_step: Compute age in the build script from the retrieval timestamp already stored in each file header.

suggestions.title: Extend depth-chart capture from 5 to all 32 clubs
suggestions.problem: Availability features cannot be compared across teams while 27 clubs are blank.
suggestions.proposal: Add one row per club to a capture list, with the club URL, a weekly timestamp, and the printed 'unofficial' label captured verbatim. Automate the fetch, diff against last week, and flag changes.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Turns a 5-club anecdote into a league-wide dataset, which is the minimum for the starter-at-risk signal to be testable.
suggestions.first_step: Fill the capture list; record the four clubs that play Thursday first, since their reports lock earliest.
suggestions.risk: Club pages change layout; a silent layout change could produce empty rows. Mitigation: the verifier fails when a chart yields zero players.

suggestions.title: Adopt a three-tier verification protocol in writing
suggestions.problem: Verification is currently a habit, not a contract.
suggestions.proposal: Tier 1: official league page (nfl.com / operations.nfl.com). Tier 2: official club page, explicitly labelled self-reported. Tier 3: independent secondary, for corroboration only. No Tier 3 value may populate a table; it may only appear in a flag's 'verified' column.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Makes an argument about a number decidable by pointing at its tier.
suggestions.first_step: Publish the protocol on the Sources page and stamp every row with its tier.
suggestions.risk: Tier 2 being treated as Tier 1 under deadline pressure. Mitigation: generator rejects a Tier 3 source URL in a data row.

suggestions.title: Build a pre-registration file per strategy before any test
suggestions.problem: Gates mean nothing if they are chosen after the results.
suggestions.proposal: One hash-sealed JSON per strategy: hypothesis, features, window, gates, staking, written before the window opens. Registering late is impossible because the hash is committed to git with a timestamp.
suggestions.first_step: Define the schema and commit one example pre-registration for a paper strategy.
suggestions.risk: Overhead slows experimentation. Mitigation: template with sane defaults so a registration takes minutes.

suggestions.title: Report ROI with and without the top 5% of tickets
suggestions.problem: A handful of long-odds winners can make a losing strategy look like a winning one.
suggestions.proposal: Show trimmed ROI beside raw ROI on every strategy row. Report the gap. Flag any strategy whose gap exceeds the margin.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Distinguishes a strategy from a lottery ticket that happened to hit.
suggestions.first_step: Add the trimmed metric to the leaderboard schema now, so it cannot be bolted on after results exist.
suggestions.risk: Trimming hides genuine big-edge bets. Mitigation: always show both; never show trimmed alone.

suggestions.title: Separate offense and defense availability indices
suggestions.problem: A single 'team health' number averages unrelated things.
suggestions.proposal: Two indices per team, each with its own weights and its own gate. Never sum them into one score for ranking.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: A team can be healthy on offense and devastated on defense; the market treats those cases very differently.
suggestions.first_step: Define the two feature sets; keep them in separate files so they cannot be accidentally merged.
suggestions.risk: Doubling the feature count doubles the multiple-comparison problem. Mitigation: correction already required by correlation.md.

suggestions.title: Add a scenario simulator for parlay pricing
suggestions.problem: Parlay and combo pricing is where the arithmetic errors concentrate.
suggestions.proposal: A small simulator that takes per-leg probabilities and a correlation matrix, samples joint outcomes, and returns the fair parlay price with an interval. Show the naive independent product next to it.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Makes the cost of assuming independence visible in one screen.
suggestions.first_step: Implement with synthetic parameters, clearly labelled as an illustration, not a market estimate.
suggestions.risk: Synthetic output mistaken for a real edge. Mitigation: watermarked 'illustrative' and excluded from the leaderboard.

suggestions.title: Dedicate the Flagged page to a numbered, sortable review queue
suggestions.problem: A long flag list with no ordering does not help anyone choose what to fix first.
suggestions.proposal: Every flag gets an id, a severity, a decision owner and a 'settles it' action. Sort by severity x blocking-ness. Show which open questions each flag unblocks.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Converts a complaint list into a work queue with a defensible order.
suggestions.first_step: Cross-link each flag to the question ids it blocks (already recorded in the JSON).
suggestions.risk: Queue grows faster than it is drained. Mitigation: show age per flag and a throughput number.

suggestions.title: Run a second independent transcription pass on the current tables
suggestions.problem: Mechanical checks caught one error; the rest are only as good as one careful read.
suggestions.proposal: Have a second session or human re-read the standings and injury tables against the live official pages, row by row, and diff against the stored TSV. Any mismatch is a flag.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: The single highest-value action for trustworthiness, and it is cheap.
suggestions.first_step: Generate a blank transcription sheet from the TSV with the value column empty, for an independent filler.
suggestions.risk: Both passes make the same systematic error (e.g. reading the wrong row). Mitigation: the second pass starts from the source page, not from our file.

suggestions.title: Publish the market scope as a versioned contract
suggestions.problem: 'We do spreads and props' is not testable; the settlement of each market differs.
suggestions.proposal: A versioned file listing each in-scope market, its settlement rule, its data source and its gate profile. Changing the scope requires a new version number.
suggestions.why_it_helps_decision_making: Stops a mid-season scope change from silently invalidating a comparison.
suggestions.first_step: Draft v0.1 with spreads and totals only, and mark props as pending.
suggestions.risk: Premature commitment. Mitigation: v0 explicitly excludes props with a stated reason.

suggestions.title: Add a 'what would change our mind' block to each strategy
suggestions.problem: Strategies get defended rather than tested.
suggestions.proposal: Each strategy states, in advance, the observation that would falsify it (e.g. 'if the effect disappears when conditioning on rest, we drop it').
suggestions.first_step: Add the field to the pre-registration schema.
suggestions.risk: Boilerplate falsifiers that are trivially unmet. Mitigation: the falsifier must name a specific test from the gate list.
